audits.transport_policy: A genuinely new bounded download client route was attempted once after fresh official resource discovery. The endpoint could not be handed to the binary downloader because the web layer could not successfully view the binary endpoint; the same failed route is not retried in a loop.
audits.source_upgrade_policy: The 17 April 2026 National Data Library and CKAN resource metadata is fresher than the previously recorded locator evidence and is retained as an official source-lineage/resource upgrade only; it is not a facility numeric-row read.
audits.exact_row_search_policy: Six high-value candidate permit/value groups were searched on the official environment.data.gov.uk domain. No indexed direct facility row was returned, so no candidate is promoted above confidence 98.
audits.cache_policy: Repository discovery did not find a reusable official raw ZIP or extracted raw-row cache. Search-index absence is not treated as authoritative uniqueness or data absence.
audits.confidence_policy: No direct official facility row was consumed; active confidence >=99 remains 220 and all candidate-only secondary numeric evidence remains capped at 98.
audits.zero_policy: Missing, unavailable, unindexed or transport-failed values remain no-data, never zero.
